title: Reported questions, commands and requests
intro: Read this before the questions on reported questions, commands and requests.

blocks.title: yes / no questions
items: **asked** + **if / whether** + subject + verb: 'Do you like tea?' → She asked **if** I **liked** tea.
The word order is a STATEMENT: no do / does / did, no question mark, and the usual tense and pronoun changes.
'Has he arrived?' → She asked **whether** he **had arrived**.

blocks.title: questions with a question word
items: **asked** + question word + subject + verb: 'Where **do** you live?' → She asked **where I lived**. Not *where did I live*.
'What **is** your name?' → He asked **what my name was**. Not *what was my name*.
If the question word is the subject, the order does not change: 'Who called?' → She asked **who had called**.

blocks.title: commands and requests
items: **Command:** told + person + **to** + verb: 'Close the door,' she told him. → She told him **to close** the door.
**Negative command:** told + person + **not to** + verb: 'Don't be late,' he told us. → He told us **not to be** late.
**Request:** asked + person + **to** + verb: 'Please help me,' she said to Tom. → She asked Tom **to help** her.

blocks.title: the slips
items: *She asked where did I live* keeps the question order. Say **where I lived**.
*He asked me did I know* has no if. Say **if I knew**.
*He told me don't touch it* keeps the command. Say **not to touch it**.
*I asked him that he help me* is wrong. Say **to help** me.
